text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Approaching the 4th corner!
This is where the real battle begins!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Time for the finishing touch.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey takes the lead!!
She speeds across Yodo, chasing the Triple Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey!!
Takes 1st place across the finish line!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Her journey to the Triple Crown has finally borne fruit here!!
It's Dream Journey!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"To think that I'd be...
the one on the side of the 'storm'......"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!! A Triple Crown Umamusume is here!!
Congrats, Dream Journeyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey is way too strong...!
Even if you're small, "a strong Umamusume is just strong"...!
Seeing it live was truly inspiring...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —For that glory, my heartfelt gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Journey-san.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I entrust that crown to you.
Dear sister—"
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)
...Overcome with emotion, I found myself at a loss for words.

I can't even bring myself to say "Congratulations."
Even though I want to celebrate with you louder than anyone else.

My mind and body trembled, and the world seemed to sway.
Standing before her imposing figure, my vision finally began to blur—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...For now, let us simply immerse ourselves in this moment.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"To our 'journey'—
and to this blessing we seized along the way."
—Cheers praising Dream Journey for making new history echoed across the grounds of Yodo.

"Until the reality of it sank in and settled into our bones,
Dream Journey and I spent a quiet moment
gazing up at the glorious scenery—"
Afterward, during the winner's interview—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"—Then, could you tell us frankly
what the single biggest factor was
that led to achieving this great feat?!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...It is remarkably difficult to narrow it down to just one.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I believe this result was made possible through the bonds with many peopleâof course including my Trainer who is here today, as well as my classmates and respected predecessors.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However...
if we're talking strictly about today's Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I believe the greatest factor in my victory was
the assistance of everyone in the Mejiro family,
who showed me how to fight in long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
What...!?
You had the support of the Mejiro family!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
Through a certain connection, we got in touch—"

"These words from Dream Journey sparked a buzz
not only among the spectators present,
but widely throughout racing fans as well—"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey had the Mejiro family
backing her up? Seriously...!
Talk about an unexpected connection~.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I haven't seen a Mejiro Umamusume around lately...
but man, they really are still strong over long distances...!

Alongside Dream Journey's great achievement,
it served as a reminder of the Mejiro family's enduring strength...
――At a later date.

Dream Journey and I were having a meeting
to confirm the destination of our next "journey."
"Taking this opportunity, I decided to verify one thing with her—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...All in all, I'd say things are going smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"—The greatest takeaway so far
has definitely been facing Vodka-san,
the 'tempest,' at the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Her running, which completely tears down the walls between different racing routes,
is bound to take the world by storm from now on...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To have run in a race that served
as such a turning point for her was the greatest stroke of luck.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: However, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As for the "ray of gold" supposed to be at the end of the "journey"...
I still haven't even caught a glimpse of its outline.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well... naturally.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
After all, we have only confronted
the "storm" once so far.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
you know what that means, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Where we ought to set our sights on next.
...The answers were limited.

A "storm" always brews at the forefront of the era,
at the cutting edge of the racing world.
If so, then our next destination is inevitably—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Exactly.

The Osaka Hai to determine the strongest in spring medium-distance.
The Tenno Sho (Spring), the longest race at 3,200m.
The fan-voted Grand Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen.

The collective name for these three GⅠ races.
That is the "Spring Senior Triple Crown."

It is an intensely demanding rotation, running it all
within a short span of about four months, yet the starting gate
attracts the finest Umamusume of the era.

If you wish to encounter many "storms,"
there could be no stage more fitting than this.

Having forged bonds with the Mejiro family, overcome her own limits,
and become a Triple Crown Umamusume,
she can surely endure this grueling rotation now.

“And I believe she can summon the 'storm' she desires,
and reach the 'streak of gold'—!”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I find that very reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: The road ahead, and the harsh trials waiting in store.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"That you will stand
and face them together with me."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let us go.
Toward spring, in pursuit of an even greater 'storm.'
choice_data_list: Ah, right! First up is the Osaka Hai!
Ah, right! First up is the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.text:
...As a Trainer,
nothing could make me happier than this.
That emotion gently welled up and spread through my chest—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Spring Senior Triple Crown"—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Among those, Ane-go ran the Tenno Sho (Spring)
and Takarazuka Kinen multiple times,
facing countless "storms" there.)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (And every time that happened, Big Sis... always looked so happy—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Haha...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a predicament.
Truly a dilemma—
Giving in to overflowing emotion, the traveler yearns for spring, a crescent smile curving across her lips—
